about: Queue for the Strong Wrists (Wrists & Hands (for push-ups, handstands, yoga)) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/wrists.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/wrists/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "wrists".

clips.name: Finger Spreads
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, both arms straight out in front at shoulder height, palms facing down, both hands squeezed into tight fists.
clips.motion: keeping the arms still, he opens both hands and spreads all the fingers as wide as possible, pauses, then squeezes them back into tight fists. Only the hands move.
clips.glow: only both forearms, from the elbow down to the wrist on the top and the underside, and both hands. No glow on the shoulders, chest or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Wrist Circles
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, elbows bent and tucked against the ribs, forearms pointing forward, fingers interlaced in front of the belly.
clips.motion: keeping the elbows still against the ribs, he draws slow full circles with both wrists together, the clasped hands rolling up, to the right, down and to the left. Only the wrists move and he never changes direction.
clips.glow: only both forearms, from the elbow down to the wrist on the top and the underside. No glow on the shoulders, chest or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Wrist Rocks
clips.start: on all fours, hands flat under the shoulders with the fingers spread and pointing forward, arms straight, knees under the hips.
clips.motion: keeping both palms flat on the floor and the arms straight, he rocks his shoulders forward past his fingertips so the wrists bend more, pauses, then rocks back until the shoulders are over the wrists again. The palms never lift.
clips.glow: only the underside of both forearms, from the inside of the elbow down to the palm. No glow on the shoulders, back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Prayer Stretch
clips.start: standing tall, palms pressed together in front of the chest with the fingers pointing up, elbows out to the sides at the height of the hands.
clips.motion: keeping the palms pressed flat together, he slowly lowers the hands toward the belly button until the wrists stretch, pauses, then raises them back in front of the chest. The palms never separate.
clips.glow: only the underside of both forearms, from the inside of the elbow down to the wrist. No glow on the shoulders, chest or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curls
clips.start: sitting on a low box, feet flat on the floor, right forearm resting on the right thigh with the palm facing up and the wrist just past the knee, right hand holding a light kettlebell by the handle, left hand resting on the left knee.
clips.motion: keeping the right forearm flat on the thigh, he curls only the right wrist up, lifting the kettlebell toward him, pauses, then lowers it slowly as the wrist bends down. Only the right hand moves and he never switches hands.
clips.glow: only the underside of the right forearm, from the inside of the right elbow down to the palm. No glow on the left arm, the shoulders or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Reverse Wrist Stretch
clips.start: kneeling on the floor and leaning forward onto straight arms, the backs of both hands flat on the floor under the shoulders with the fingers pointing back toward the knees.
clips.motion: keeping the backs of the hands flat on the floor and the arms straight, he slowly sits his hips back toward his heels until the tops of the forearms stretch, pauses, then shifts forward again. The hands never move.
clips.glow: only the top of both forearms, from the outside of the elbow down to the back of the hand. No glow on the shoulders, back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Fingers-Back Wrist Stretch
clips.start: kneeling on the floor and leaning forward onto straight arms, palms flat on the floor under the shoulders with the fingers pointing back toward the knees.
clips.motion: keeping the palms flat on the floor and the arms straight, he slowly sits his hips back toward his heels until the undersides of the forearms stretch, pauses, then shifts forward again. The palms never lift and the hands never move.
clips.glow: only the underside of both forearms, from the inside of the elbow down to the palm. No glow on the shoulders, back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Fingertip Lifts
clips.start: in a kneeling plank: knees on the floor, hands flat under the shoulders with the fingers spread and pointing forward, arms straight, body straight from head to knees.
clips.motion: keeping the arms straight and the fingertips on the floor, he presses down through his fingers so both palms lift off the floor and the hands become cupped, pauses, then lowers the palms flat again. The knees stay down and he never does a push-up.
clips.glow: only the underside of both forearms, from the inside of the elbow down to the fingertips. No glow on the shoulders, back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Reverse Wrist Curls
clips.start: sitting on a low box, feet flat on the floor, right forearm resting on the right thigh with the palm facing down and the wrist just past the knee, right hand holding a light kettlebell by the handle, left hand resting on the left knee.
clips.motion: keeping the right forearm flat on the thigh, he lifts only the back of the right hand up, raising the kettlebell, pauses, then lowers it slowly as the wrist bends down. Only the right hand moves and he never switches hands.
clips.glow: only the top of the right forearm, from the outside of the right elbow down to the back of the hand. No glow on the left arm, the shoulders or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Fist Rocks
clips.start: on all fours with both hands closed into fists, the flat front of the knuckles on the floor under the shoulders, wrists straight, arms straight, knees under the hips.
clips.motion: keeping the wrists straight and the fists planted, he rocks his shoulders forward past his fists, pauses, then rocks back until the shoulders are over the fists again. The fists never open.
clips.glow: only both forearms, from the elbow down to the wrist all around, and both fists. No glow on the shoulders, back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Kneeling Planche Lean
clips.start: in a kneeling plank: knees on the floor, hands flat under the shoulders with the fingers pointing forward, arms locked straight, body straight from head to knees.
clips.motion: keeping the arms locked straight and the palms flat, he leans his whole body forward until his shoulders are well in front of his hands, pauses, then shifts back until the shoulders are over the wrists. The elbows never bend and the knees stay down.
clips.glow: only the underside of both forearms, from the inside of the elbow down to the palm, and the front of both shoulders. No glow on the back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Planche Lean
clips.start: in a high plank on the toes, hands flat under the shoulders with the fingers pointing forward, arms locked straight, body in one straight line from head to heels.
clips.motion: keeping the arms locked straight, the palms flat and the body rigid, he leans forward on his toes until his shoulders are well in front of his hands, pauses, then shifts back until the shoulders are over the wrists. The elbows never bend and he never does a push-up.
clips.glow: only the underside of both forearms, from the inside of the elbow down to the palm, the front of both shoulders and the abs on the front of the belly. No glow on the back or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
